C0300.title: KillNet Group Leverages CC-Attack Script for DDoS Campaigns
C0300.summary: SecurityScorecard analysis reveals that the hacktivist group KillNet is using a script called CC-Attack to launch distributed denial-of-service attacks. The script automates the exploitation of open proxy servers to relay attack traffic, flooding target servers with forged HTTP requests to exhaust resources, characteristic of a typical challenge collapsar attack.

references.title: KillNet Utilizes CC-Attack: A Quick & Dirty DDoS Method
